title: Microchip Technology (MCHP) Has Two New Robotics And Industrial Network Hooks
summary: Microchip Technology (NasdaqGS:MCHP) launched the ATFCD52 high speed capacitance digitizer for robotic tactile sensing and grip control. These updates target uses in advanced robotics, augmented reality devices and smart infrastructure systems. title: Microchip Technology (MCHP) Stock: $58.35, Down 10.02% Nov 6 - JournalArta
MCHP Q3 CY2026 deep dive: data center design wins offset by cautious outlook and supply constraints
summary: Analog chipmaker Microchip Technology (NASDAQ:MCHP) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q2 2027), with sales up 42.2% year on year to $1.62 billion. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $1.61 billion was less impressive, coming in 1.4% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.97 per share was 3.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
